bol.resumo: Flávio Nantes Bolsonaro was born on April 30, 1981, in Resende (RJ), son of Jair Bolsonaro and Rogéria Nantes Braga. He graduated in Law from Universidade Candido Mendes. He was a state deputy for Rio de Janeiro (Alerj) for four terms between 2003 and 2019, and has been a senator for Rio de Janeiro since 2019, elected for the PSL. He passed through PPB/PP, PSC, PSL, Republicanos and Patriota before joining the PL in November 2021.

zem.resumo: Romeu Zema Neto was born on October 28, 1964, in Araxá (MG), great-grandson of the Italian immigrant Domenico Zema, founder of the family's business group. He graduated in Business Administration from FGV and headed the Grupo Zema between 1990 and 2016. According to the TSE, he was affiliated with the PR (now PL) from December 1999 to January 2018, when he joined the NOVO party. He was elected governor of Minas Gerais in 2018 and reelected in 2022, holding the office until 2026.

ren.resumo: Renan Antônio Ferreira dos Santos was born on February 14, 1984, in São Paulo (SP), in the east zone of the city. He began the Law course at USP but did not complete it, leaving the university to work with his father, a businessman. In 2014, he founded the Movimento Brasil Livre (MBL), of which he is the main strategist. He founded the Missão party, registered civilly in October 2023 and approved by the TSE in November 2025, for which he is running for the Presidency in 2026.

lul.resumo: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva was born on October 27, 1945, in Caetés (PE), son of Aristides Inácio da Silva and Eurídice Ferreira de Melo. He worked as a metalworker and lathe operator in the ABC region of São Paulo, and was elected president of the Sindicato dos Metalúrgicos de São Bernardo do Campo e Diadema in 1975. He was a co-founder and the first president of the Partido dos Trabalhadores (PT), founded in February 1980, the party to which he remains affiliated. He was President of the Republic between 2003 and 2010, and again from 2023.

cai.resumo: Ronaldo Ramos Caiado was born on September 25, 1949, in Anápolis (GO), grandson of the politician Antônio Ramos Caiado. He graduated in Medicine from UFRJ and worked as an orthopedist and rural producer, having presided over the União Democrática Ruralista (UDR) between 1986 and 1989. He was a federal deputy for Goiás for five terms (1991-2014) and a senator (2015-2018). Governor of Goiás since 2019, reelected in 2022, he left União Brasil and joined the PSD on January 27, 2026, to run for the Presidency.

mar.resumo: Pablo Henrique Costa Marçal was born on April 18, 1987, in Goiânia (GO). He graduated in Law and worked as a call center agent at Brasil Telecom before becoming a lecturer, coach and businessman in the personal development sector. He was a pre-candidate for the Presidency for the PROS in 2022 and a candidate for mayor of São Paulo for the PRTB in 2024. In 2026, he passed through União Brasil before returning to the PRTB, on August 15, by a preliminary injunction, the party for which he is running for the Presidency.

cur.resumo: Augusto Jorge Cury was born on October 2, 1958, in Colina (SP). He graduated in Medicine from the Faculdade de Medicina de São José do Rio Preto, with postgraduate studies at PUC-SP and a doctorate in Multifocal Psychology from Florida Christian University. He works as a psychiatrist, writer and lecturer, and is the author of more than 70 books. With no previously known record of party affiliation, he joined Avante in 2026 and had his candidacy for the Presidency made official by the party on August 3, 2026.

rui.resumo: Rui Costa Pimenta was born on June 25, 1957, in São Paulo (SP), son of the journalist Floreal Costa Pimenta and of the lawyer and labor judge Ivone Catelli Pimenta. He graduated in Journalism from Faculdade Cásper Líbero and studied Languages and Literature at USP. He was a co-founder of the PT in 1980 and was elected a director of the CUT in Greater São Paulo in 1985, breaking with the PT in 1992. He founded the Partido da Causa Operária (PCO) in 1995, with definitive registration in 1996, of which he is the national president and for which he has already run for the Presidency in other elections.
